findings.claim: The new pass wording landed in claude.hook instead of antigravity.hook.
drop_apm_okf_stop's single changed flag deleted named hooks that were already empty.
Row r1's command ran no test of the plugin folder's two named hooks and their flat handlers.

apm_okf_stop_present reads the raw text of .agents/hooks.json, but drop_apm_okf_stop skips a file that is not valid JSON. For such a file, doctor names a fix that changes nothing. Deferred to the stub antigravity-okf-stop-hook-reviewer-f4.

verdict.text: Both fixes sent back are correct.
claude.hook's pass line again names only the SessionStart hook.
antigravity.hook's line names both hooks, and the how-to's sample output matches both.
drop_apm_okf_stop now tracks a drop for each named hook, so a hook that was already empty stays, and the test now covers that case.
f3 is fixed by a renamed structure test plus a new okf_stop test.
f4 stays open as non-blocking hardening, deferred to its own ticket.
The stamp is green, so the change can land.
Ran `loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree with a scratch HOME.
lint, format, tests and integration pass, and eval rows r1 to r6 pass.
Result: `stamp green: f6e3b481c2f4979f2ba3c17b9c533461a1c13f0cd12273a6499d0504b9d9da63`, which matches the open round's fingerprint.
The scratch HOME had no git identity, so loopctl put off its state commit.
The stamp is staged in the primary checkout.
doctor.py: `_claude_hook` (line 395) has its original wording, and `git diff` shows no change to it.
`_antigravity_hook` (line 486) names the SessionStart hook and okf's Stop check.
Lines 359 and 366 of the how-to's sample output match each check word for word.
antigravity.py:302-322: `dropped` is reset for each named hook.
A named hook is deleted only when that hook lost an okf handler and has no events left.
`changed` collects the drops and controls the write.
tests/test_antigravity.py:1096: the fixture puts `"empty": {}` after `"apm"`, so the old code would have deleted it after the apm drop.
The expected dict keeps it, so this test fails on the old code.
A second install leaves the file's bytes the same.
tests/test_antigravity.py:1155 `test_okf_stop_plugin_hooks_hold_both_flat_handlers` matches r1's `-k okf_stop`.
It checks that there are exactly the two named hooks and that kmctl-okf-stop's single Stop handler is the flat handler.
f1: resolved at src/kmctl/doctor.py:486 and in the how-to's sample output (lines 359 and 366).
f2: resolved at src/kmctl/antigravity.py:306-319.
The test at tests/test_antigravity.py:1096 now covers an already-empty named hook.
f3: resolved by tests/test_antigravity.py:1155, which r1's command selects.
f4: still open as non-blocking hardening.
apm_okf_stop_present is unchanged, as the briefing said.
It is tracked by the deferred stub antigravity-okf-stop-hook-reviewer-f4.
Outside this narrow round, and not a finding: the install note at src/kmctl/plugin.py:999 and its copy at the how-to's line 101 list "the SessionStart hook" but not the Stop hook.
The how-to's sample doctor output also has no `antigravity.apm-hooks` line.
Worth a look the next time those lines change.
